description: Stopped once a link is removed, the guard turned off, before the operation is done: the reprise finds it gone and finishes it, and the next pass removes the rest.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
[deletes.mass_guard]
percent = "100%"
[modifies.mass_guard]
percent = "100%"
[trash]
link_guard = true
